decisions.reason: The construction dumper was only mentioned in passing and sits outside the lift line, and the firm quickly dropped its other underground vehicles, which suggests weak results and little slack to carry it, but there is no clear evidence yet of a shortfall serious enough to force a drop.
The inclined furniture lift line has its own page and several models, so it looks like a coherent core offering whose results likely meet aspirations in a stable niche market.
The building material lift shares technology and customers with the furniture lifts, so it is cheap to keep, and satisfactory niche demand gives no trigger for search.
The truck-mounted lift has its own page and complements the lift range, though as a single, more capital-intensive model it is somewhat more at risk if sales fall short.
